steps.content: [VIP Lounge]

You follow the directions, stepping through the VIP corridor into the lounge before taking a seat at the negotiation table. Across from you sits the Fraser advisor, Adelaide Campbell. Behind him, a row of Outlands officials stand motionless, their faces obscured.

You're alone, with only the minimalist guard-type Schorl sent by Paradeisos hidden in your coat pocket. Over a dozen cameras watch from the walls, their unblinking lenses feeding live to DisCity Public Security headquarters.
—You know they are aware of all this. This is DisCity's home turf, and Adelaide himself knows it well. His friendly smile never wavers as he gazes at you.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Thank you for your assistance, Chief ${PlayerName}, and please accept my apologies for the trouble our delegation has caused you.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: After such extensive travels, their exhaustion was understandable. Combine that with the language barriers, and occasional mishaps became inevitable. Your security intervention was most fortunate. I've long admired your professional reputation and have been looking forward to making your acquaintance.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: But you don't seem to trust me.

That's only natural after the 9th Agency recently busted several bribed Eastside councilors who were helping Quinn infiltrate Hypercube transportation networks. Quinn's president, Eirene, turned out to be a Fraser operative hiding her identity, with her full name being <color=#fb9259>Eirene Campbell</color>. You've seen her methods firsthand.
Now, a Fraser advisor from the Campbell family specifically invites you here under the banner of the Great Expo. Clearly, he isn't looking to make friends. Not at a time like this.

steps.speaker: Option
options: And you don't seem you're simply passing by.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: I'm merely here as a civilian advisor. The Fraser ambassador is meeting with DisCity's officials, and since I'm not among the invited, I thought I'd take this opportunity to look around.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: I understand that explanation may not fully alleviate your concerns. Allow me to be perfectly clear, then.
As he speaks, he draws a photograph from inside his coat and slides it toward you.
You recognize the face in the photograph, and the realization strikes like a fist to the chest.
[Photo of Hella and Hypatia]

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Ah, I suppose you recognize the people in this photo? Excellent. That gives us quite a lot to discuss.

steps.speaker: Option
options: ...What do you want to talk about?

steps.content: Schorl emits an imperceptible flash of light, a silent reminder for you to steady yourself. But your breath still quickens, your heart hammering against your chest, each beat echoing through your skull like a war drum.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: I'd like to talk about this remarkable girl. She left behind her home and family to journey alone, enduring countless hardships. And despite her youth, she had to stand firm against an Apostle in the very eye of the ash storm.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: While it pains me to witness her struggles, I can't help but feel joy knowing how rapidly she has grown with each trial.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Who could have imagined that timid child, always hiding behind her siblings, would grow into the most reliable Aurum Secretum researcher, revered as a true scientific visionary? As her brother, I could not be prouder.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: My lovely little sister, <color=#fb9259>Hypatia Campbell</color>, of course.
He points to a face in the photograph—someone you have never seen before. Not Hella, but the blonde girl beside her.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: She is the youngest in our family, yet the most conscientious, forever burdened by others' expectations. Our lineage demands she upholds its legacy, refugees look to her for compassion, and these turbulent times require her to wield wisdom, power, and courage... And through it all, she has never faltered. Such dedication, wouldn't you agree?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: This marks her first true friendship. See how her face blossoms with joy. Admittedly, I find her bewildered tears and the fearful glances she gives me equally endearing... though I must say, she really should smile more often at her age.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Ah, by the way, my sister's new friend is a Sinner from MBCC. You must be acquainted with her, I presume? Hypa invited her to visit Fraser, and they were likely going to celebrate a birthday together. Regrettably, my DisCity business trip coincides perfectly to make me miss the occasion.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: However, this trip does offer one compensation—the opportunity to reunite with another wayward sister of mine. <color=#fb9259>Eirene Campbell</color>, Quinn's president and, as I'm told, another acquaintance of yours?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Eirene seems to hold you in remarkably high regard. Makes me quite envious, frankly. When I paid my visit yesterday, I didn't earn so much as a smile.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: By the way, Chief, if I might ask, what DisCity gifts would you suggest for younger siblings? I've been browsing the exhibition, yet I find myself quite indecisive. Let me tell you about their personalities first...
A long time has passed...

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Thank you for your thoughtful suggestions. I've taken note of each one. They're most appreciated.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: My father is a man of wandering affections who follows his every whim. But because of that, I've been blessed with many siblings, each precious, each deserving of love. And I cherish them dearly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Now I completely understand why your siblings tend to avoid you.
Schorl trembles ever so slightly, and you immediately understand the unspoken message.

steps.speaker: Option
options: But surely an advisor like you wouldn't have invited me here just for casual conversation, right?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Ah, my apologies. I didn't mean to take up your time. It's just you strike me as someone who values family as I do, so I couldn't help but ramble on.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Then let's get back to business.
Adelaide's gaze, smile, and posture remain completely unchanged, yet somehow, everything about him feels different.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: My sister Hypatia is an expert in Aurum Secretum research. With Fraser's support, she's pioneering the development of this Mania-resonant metal, hoping to use Aurum Secretum to steer the Apostles of Ashes away from populated areas and shield human settlements from these calamities.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: The exhibit of the people you just protected is a practical application of her research. Whenever there's a technological breakthrough, Fraser actively promotes it to all shelters. In today's Hypercube shortage, this helps people find alternative ways to protect themselves.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: However, we've recently uncovered a disturbing development: our Aurum Secretum—designed for protection—has been corrupted and weaponized. Someone is now using it to forcibly resonate with the Apostles of Ashes, intending to harness their malevolent power for sinister purposes.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Chief, I can see this matter weighs equally on you. You've been investigating the Outland Sinner who attacked the former Speaker of DisCity, believing the mysterious power the perpetrator used is connected to our Aurum Secretum, correct?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Please, don't hesitate to ask whatever you need. I'm fully aware of the suspicions surrounding Fraser, and you have my word that I'll be as transparent as possible to earn your trust and assist with your investigation. This is to prove our innocence and preserve the peace between our two city-states.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Whenever you're ready.

steps.speaker: Option
options: The connection between Aurum Secretum and the Apostles of Ashes

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Our enemy clearly possesses some kind of metal that strongly resonates with Ash Crystals, even channeling the power of the Apostles of Ashes. If that is indeed Aurum Secretum, we need samples for further study.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: The Fraser ambassador is currently discussing this matter with DisCity representatives. Some samples have already been submitted to the Ring Research Institute.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: With all respect, Chief, Fraser's Aurum Secretum research focuses solely on civilian safety applications, which differs from the modified version the attacker employed. The data we're providing may have limited utility against your enemy.
He hands over a specification document.

Classification: Resonant Synthetic Metal | Extraction Grade: S | Safety Level: High
Code Name: Aurum Secretum
Source: Fraser Rare Earth Minerals
Usage: Aurum Secretum's core mechanism relies on its powerful resonance and amplification properties. When fused with DisCity's precious Hypercube medium, it can be forged into various protective devices capable of resisting Mania-corrupted environments and diverting the paths of calamities.
Except for high-purity Aurum Secretum, standard Aurum Secretum devices exhibit exceptional safety ratings and are extensively deployed across Fraser.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Not everyone can use Aurum Secretum. Its powerful resonance properties require users to share compatible Mania attributes, which means only select Sinners with specific affinities can wield it effectively. This creates a fundamental distinction from Hypercubes, you see.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: After years of investigation, Fraser has compiled a list of suspects, including the perpetrator Jelena. This list has already been submitted to the 9th Agency by our ambassador. We hope it proves valuable to your efforts.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: From your perspective, all people outside DisCity are collectively referred to as the Outlanders, but the reality is far more nuanced. The Outlands consist of countless scattered communities, each with its own scale, level of development, and distinct ideologies.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Fraser inherited substantial pre-Nightfall assets and trade routes, which naturally positioned us as a hub between settlements. The Farland Alliance was thus formed, a cooperative framework for mutual support and resource sharing in the post-Nightfall era.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: However, the Farland Alliance does not—and cannot—extend to all settlements. Even among our members, we cannot compel factions to alter their stances. Many conflicts persist, resistant to quick resolution, and the grievances of years are not so easily set aside.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Nevertheless, Fraser's priorities lie in commerce. Our advocacy for peace and our active promotion of the Great Expo are driven in part by a desire to mend relations between DisCity and the Outlands. I must say, I hold particularly high hopes for this Expo's success.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Beyond this matter, there's crucial intelligence I must deliver to you personally.
He clasps his hands together and leans forward, his gaze at you growing more intent.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Aurum Secretum was initially designed solely to alter environmental Mania fields, with no capability of evoking resonance between Sinners and the Apostles of Ashes. Through secret investigation, I discovered that those who distorted our technology belong to an underground network... a mysterious organization. I hear they go by a different name here...

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>The DisCity dark web</color>, or as you might call them, the Underground. They are your enemy, are they not?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...! You're saying the Underground is behind all this?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: They are indeed stirring animosity among Outlanders towards DisCity, and Jelena can't be the only Aurum Secretum user. The Outlands are vast, sparsely populated, and ravaged by calamities, making both investigations and apprehensions difficult. While Fraser acknowledges the threat, we lack the resources to address it fully. Frankly, some may have already infiltrated through the Great Expo.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: —But I'm sure you've already taken all of this into account, hence your vigilance towards me and readiness for conflict. However, what I wish to convey is that this approach alone may not suffice to resolve all issues.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Hatred requires fertile ground to take root and grow. Unless DisCity reconsiders its approach toward the Outlands, I fear you will only end up cultivating more enemies.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What are you getting at?
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...It's been too long. They've kept Chief in there for too long.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: If what you're saying is true, that someone made that accident happen on purpose to make Chief show up... why would they do that?

${PlayerName} may be crucial to anti-Mania operations, yet holds no sway in diplomatic affairs. Among the group gathered just now—a representative from Nirvana, an advisor from Fraser, and a financier known as the stock market guru from Eastside—what could they be discussing?

Recently, Nirvana has been flooding the market with signals: during the Great Expo, they will negotiate Aurum Secretum technology cooperation with Fraser to optimize unmanned mechanical mining systems. To cut risk while severing their reliance on the West District's manual miners.

During the height of the Outlander spy investigations earlier, Nirvana reclaimed a considerable share of external Hypercube trade and transportation from Quinn. Though they've since conceded some control in their deal with Fraser, the benefit is already reaped—their stock prices have skyrocketed to unprecedented levels.

Nirvana and Fraser have also rallied the support of many influential figures. Their machine is in motion, and those who oppose them will be ground to dust. Profit is their only creed, and for it, they will burn the world to ashes. To them, ${PlayerName} is just another pawn, a bargaining chip with moderate value.
But what troubles her even more is...

She bites her lip as memories flood back to her final conversation with that person before his death. Stewart, clutching a half-burned incense stick, had urged his daughter to commit its scent to memory.

steps.speaker: Stewart
steps.content: You're my daughter, and one day you'll inevitably walk down my path. So remember what I've told you, and stay away from this scent.

steps.speaker: Stewart
steps.content: No matter what they promise you, no matter how desperate your situation becomes, you stay away from them. The price is far more than you can bear.
Elvira's jaw locks. That scent sears her memory even now. Of course she would recognize it instantly.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: That woman just now has the same scent on her. If those people are involved and making deals with Fraser...

Suspicions pile up like storm clouds in Elvira's mind, pulling her deeper into thought until words spill out—unfiltered, unguarded. But she is no longer hidden in that safe cage. Here, every word voiced carries a price.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Are you saying that Chief is in danger?

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: This is just my hunch. I...
She wants to say she might be overthinking things, but it's already too late. Hecate instinctively tenses up, causing Nightmare to expand, and then...
[Alarm Blaring]

steps.speaker: Fraser Ambassador
steps.content: Advisor! Mania detected. It's an ambush!
Schorl emerges from your pocket.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Conflict identified. Switching to Combat Mode. Threat elimination imminent—
